The area of a polygon whose vertices are $(x_0,y_0), (x_1,y_1), \ldots, (x_{n-1},y_{n-1})$ (ordered counter-clockwise around the perimeter) can be calculated using the Shoelace formula:
Area $= \frac{1}{2} | \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (x_i y_{i+1} - x_{i+1} y_i) |$, where $(x_n, y_n) = (x_0, y_0)$.
